description: Land Title Settlement Department - Rajanganaya Yaya 2, Rajanganaya D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110184
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for multiple parcels in Rajanganaya. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels, their extents, ownership details (primarily "The State" and "Irrigation Department"), and land classification information. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it concerns land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title matters.
